⛏️ Introducing Hashr

Hashr is building an onchain mining ecosystem where instead of mining traditional cryptocurrencies, users can mine tokenized markets.

Robinhood Chain is the starting point.

Our long-term plan is to expand Hashr across Solana, BNB Chain, Base and other ecosystems, creating a multichain mining network with different assets, communities and opportunities on every chain.

As Hashr expands, we want to introduce more mining pools, more assets, community features, live market data, leaderboards, mining boosts, events and entirely new ways for users to interact with onchain markets.

The goal is to turn mining into an experience.
